which is how `sofar doctor` sees that a promoted fact reached repo memory.

- **M1** (2026-08-13T10:30:12.056Z) — Cross-initiative recency on a hook path goes through core/warmth.ts — newestEvent/lastAppendAt read only the log's TAIL, so they are O(1) in log size and cost about 0.03 ms per initiative (1.7 ms across 38 initiatives, 5.3 MB, measured 2026-08-13). Never reach for core/listing.ts listInitiatives there: it folds every log, which is what `sofar list` can afford and a 100 ms shim cannot. Two traps that look equivalent and are not: filesystem mtime is dishonest because `git checkout` rewrites every events.jsonl in the tree, and cli/event.ts's local lastEventMs reads the WHOLE file (it predates warmth and is only affordable because the cold-resume path calls it once, for one initiative).
